subject: Skips the internal clients from logresreq checks (#3154)
reason: The change only touches reqresShouldLog() in src/logreqres.c, which is entirely inside #ifdef LOG_REQ_RES — a compile-time feature the Makefile enables only for the reply-schema validation CI tooling, and which is driven solely by the hidden, immutable req-res-logfile config that itself exists only under that macro. In a normal build (the build the fuzzer runs) all of these functions are no-ops, and the feature only ever writes an internal debug log file: it has no observable effect on replies, data, replication, persistence, or liveness. The fix prevents a serverAssert crash when internal/fak
